newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $33.26 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $33.26 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold 700 million rupees in treasury bills at its weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 347.0 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 7.85 percent at the Thursday auction, against 430.0 million rupees at 7.94 percent last week.
The bank sold 182-day bills worth 246.0 million rupees at an average yield of 7.92 percent, against 242.0 million rupees at 8.01 percent last week.
The bank sold 364-day bills worth 107.0 million rupees at an average yield of 8.03 percent, against 128.0 million rupees at 8.14 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 7.90 percent per annum from 7.99 percent last week, the bank said.
